findings.title: JavaScript-only rendering (Venia PWA default)
findings.description: The entire site requires JavaScript to render. Without SSR or pre-rendering, search engines index an empty page. Google's crawl budget is wasted and organic traffic is severely suppressed.
findings.root_cause: Magento PWA Studio (Venia) default configuration ships as a client-side only SPA with no server-side rendering enabled.

findings.title: Slow mobile load time (~4-6s estimated LCP)
findings.description: Venia PWA's default PageSpeed score can be as low as 9/100 on mobile. Every extra second of load time reduces conversions by 7-20%.
findings.root_cause: Unoptimized JavaScript bundle size, no CDN edge caching, uncompressed images, no lazy loading.

findings.title: No customer reviews or social proof
findings.description: Product pages lack ratings, reviews, and user-generated content. In traditional menswear, fit and fabric quality are major purchase concerns. Without social proof, hesitant buyers abandon.
findings.root_cause: No review platform integrated. Magento native reviews not configured or not displayed.

findings.title: Missing urgency and scarcity signals
findings.description: No 'low stock' indicators, countdown timers for promotions, or 'X people viewing this' social proof. Urgency mechanics are industry-standard CRO levers.
findings.root_cause: Not configured in Magento/Venia. No urgency plugin installed.

findings.title: Weak product discovery — limited filters and faceted search
findings.description: With a large catalog of thobes and menswear across styles, sizes, and fabrics, customers cannot easily narrow results. Poor product discovery leads to high bounce rates.
findings.root_cause: Default Magento layered navigation not fully configured. Elasticsearch not deployed.

findings.title: No persistent cart or guest checkout optimization
findings.description: Requiring account creation before checkout is one of the #1 cart abandonment causes globally. Guest checkout with optional post-purchase registration is the established best practice.
findings.root_cause: Magento checkout configuration. Guest checkout may be disabled or not prominently offered.

findings.title: Thin SEO content on category and product pages
findings.description: Category pages lack descriptive copy, FAQs, or buying guides. The site is invisible for non-branded search terms like 'best thobe Saudi Arabia'.
findings.root_cause: Content strategy gap. No editorial team producing category-level SEO content.

findings.title: Poor size guidance and fabric information
findings.description: Traditional menswear buyers need detailed fit guides and fabric descriptions. Missing this content increases return rates and reduces purchase confidence.
findings.root_cause: Product data incomplete in Magento PIM. No size guide pages created.

findings.title: No abandoned cart email/SMS recovery sequence
findings.description: Without cart abandonment sequences (email + SMS at 1, 6, and 24 hours), the site leaves 70-80% of would-be buyers without a recovery mechanism.
findings.root_cause: No email marketing automation configured. No transactional SMS provider integrated.

findings.title: No personalization or recommendation engine
findings.description: The homepage shows the same content to every visitor regardless of purchase history or browsing behavior. Personalization can lift revenue per visitor by 10-30%.
findings.root_cause: No recommendation engine (e.g., Algolia Recommend, Nosto) integrated.

findings.title: Limited payment options — no BNPL
findings.description: In KSA, Tamara and Tabby (local BNPL providers) have become standard. Without BNPL, the site loses conversions on higher AOV items like premium thobes.
findings.root_cause: Tamara/Tabby payment modules not installed in Magento.

findings.title: Accessibility gaps
findings.description: As a PWA built on React, ensuring ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, and color contrast is often overlooked. This limits reach and may create legal exposure.
findings.root_cause: No accessibility audit performed during development. Venia defaults may not meet WCAG 2.1 AA.

strengths.title: 45-Year Brand Heritage
strengths.description: Dominant brand recognition across KSA and Gulf markets. High baseline trust.
strengths.impact: Reduces customer acquisition cost; increases direct traffic

strengths.title: Structured Product Catalog
strengths.description: Logical category hierarchy covering men, women, children across traditional and contemporary menswear.
strengths.impact: Provides solid foundation for enhanced filtering and SEO

strengths.title: Bilingual Arabic/English Experience
strengths.description: Arabic-first design acknowledges primary audience cultural preference.
strengths.impact: Reduces bounce rate for Arabic-speaking customers; improves trust

strengths.title: Free Delivery Threshold (199 SAR)
strengths.description: Free delivery incentive drives customers to increase basket size.

strengths.title: PWA Architecture
strengths.description: Magento PWA Studio provides the foundation for app-like experiences when properly optimized.
strengths.impact: Enables push notifications, offline capability, home screen install

strengths.title: Enterprise Scale & Brand Authority
strengths.description: 25+ countries, 5,000-9,999 employees, major corporate partnerships (Bahri, Marubeni, QNB).
strengths.impact: Credibility signals that smaller competitors cannot replicate
